scripts.cert: IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || echo 127.0.0.1) && mkdir -p .cert && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 30 -keyout .cert/key.pem -out .cert/cert.pem -subj /CN=pomidoro-dev -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1,IP:$IP" -addext "nameConstraints=critical,permitted;DNS:localhost,permitted;IP:127.0.0.1/255.255.255.255,permitted;IP:$IP/255.255.255.255" && chmod 600 .cert/key.pem
